question.text: Regulation 23 of the SEBI (AIF) Regulations requires that for securities with no valuation norm prescribed under SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations, valuation shall be carried out as per guidelines endorsed by:

answer.text: An AIF industry association representing at least 33% of registered AIFs, with AIPAC recommendations considered

explanation.text: The Logic: Reg 23 per the chapter: 'Valuation of securities, for which no valuation norm is prescribed... shall be carried out as per valuation guidelines endorsed by any AIF industry association, which in terms of membership represents at least 33% of the number of SEBI registered AIFs. Such industry association shall endorse appropriate valuation guidelines after taking into account recommendations of AIPAC of SEBI.' APMI is the endorsed body. The Trap: RBI/MCA/investee-board are wrong regulators for AIF valuation. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C and XIX-D test Reg 23 identically.
